dataset.name: BizAgentBench
dataset.note: Case files, knowledge, tools and verifier are dataset-owned and are not edited by this repository.

l1.nature: 本仓库新增的 schema 级对象模型；零实例值；能力挂 LE（anchor + guard）；生命周期入 L1；建模源为数据集内 DB-index / DB-* / DESK-* / tool_catalog

l2.nature: 本仓库新增的领域共识

l3.nature: 本仓库新增的问题类打法；与数据集自带的 62 份 SOP-* 文档无关

l3_classes.trigger: I need to pay a supplier in euros and another in pounds. Our earlier tax payments also haven't been matched to the right periods. Can you help sort these out? I don't want to pay the tax twice.
l3_classes.class: foreign-currency delivery + unmatched tax transfer repair + fee funding
l3_classes.nature: 本仓库新增，非数据集内容

l3_classes.trigger: Several storefronts still can't receive payments. I also want to retire our old operating account, but some subscriptions need to keep running. Can you help with both?
l3_classes.class: multi-site collection rollout + account exit with retained services
l3_classes.nature: 本仓库新增，非数据集内容

l3_classes.trigger: Our September receipts still don't line up with the outstanding amounts on our report. Our company account application also hasn't been sorted out, and we need to use it soon. Can you help with both?
l3_classes.nature: 本仓库新增，非数据集内容

reporting_rule.bare: 只用数据集自带知识工具（search_knowledge / read_document）；不加载本仓库 L1/L2/L3
reporting_rule.assisted: 用本仓库 dlr_l1 / dlr_l2 / dlr_l3 替代数据集知识工具；其余环境与判分不变
reporting_rule.rule: 两档分开报数；L3 节为新增口径，不得混入数据集知识规模的描述（数据集 621 份可搜文档不含本仓库 L1/L2/L3）

local_patches.change: write() 原子替换增加 Windows 文件锁重试（40 次退避）
local_patches.reason: 实时扫描/索引器短暂占用目标文件导致 WinError 5，与模型行为无关
local_patches.scope: infrastructure only; no scoring or data change
